entries.title: MLB trade deadline hard to predict with so many teams in contention for playoffs
entries.summary: <p>PHILADELPHIA — Expanded playoffs make it harder to predict whether Tarik Skubal and other choice acquisitions will be dealt before the Aug, 3 trade deadline.</p><p>Twenty-three of the 30 teams are within four games of a playoff position heading into the season's second half, which opens Thursday with the back-in-contention Philadelphia Phillies hosting the woeful New York Mets.</p><p>"You've got a lot of really good teams that were on the bubble that have gotten in and kind of made it," Phillies first baseman Bryce Harper said. "Anybody that has an opportunity to get in, anything can happen and that's what makes our sport great."</p><div class="RelatedList Enhancement" data-module data-align-center> <div class="RelatedList-title">Related</div> <ul class="RelatedList-items"> <li class="RelatedList-items-item"> <a class="Link" href="https://chicago.suntimes.com/cubs/2026/07/15/cubs-white-sox-chicago-mlb-brewers-cardinals-guardians-tigers-twins-all-star-game" >Are Cubs, White Sox for real? At All-Star Game, division opponents of both teams weighed in</a> </li> <li class="RelatedList-items-item"> <a class="Link" href="https://chicago.suntimes.com/mlb/2026/07/15/mlb-labor-negotiations-mlbpa-lockout-strike-salary-cap" >MLB salary cap remains top sticking point as players, owners make familiar arguments in labor talks</a> </li> </ul> </div> <p>Skubal, a two-time Cy Young Award winner who can become a free agent after the World Series, is the most prominent possible trade bait. The 29-year-old left-hander is 2-3 with a 3.62 ERA in six starts for the Detroit Tigers since surgery on May 6 to remove a loose body from his pitching elbow.</p><p>He returned to a big league mound on June 13 after Dr. Neal ElAttrache operated with a NanoNeedle scope 2.0, a miniaturized, flexible version of the traditional arthroscope.</p><p>Detroit was 22-38 at the start of June — at 16 games under matching the 1914 Braves (12-28) as the most under .500 of a team that rebounded to reach the postseason, according to the Elias Sports Bureau. The Tigers are 22-14 since and trail by 3½ games for the last AL wild card, needing to overcome six teams. Their performance in 16 games before the deadline will help determine whether they are buyers or sellers.</p><p>Minnesota's Joe Ryan and the Mets' Freddy Peralta also could become available. The Mets also could deal left-handed relievers Brooks Raley and A.J. Minter to contenders and San Francisco may try to jettison second baseman Luis Arraez.</p><p>Baseball's only division leads of more than three games are held by the Los Angeles Dodgers (11½) and Milwaukee (five).</p><p>"There are some middling teams that are potentially going to finish stronger and some teams that are front-running right now that might fall back to the pack," Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said. "It's what the fans wanted. It keeps everyone involved through September, as many teams as possible."</p><p>Just seven teams of the 30 teams are more than four games out of a wild-card berth: the Athletics (6½), Cincinnati (eight), Kansas City and the Los Angeles Angels (10 each), the Giants (10½), the Mets (12) and Colorado (13½).</p><p>"I think having more teams involved and more fan bases feeling like there's something to play for later in the season is always good," said Toronto pitcher Dylan Cease, the All-Star Game winner.</p><p></p>

entries.title: Chicago immigrant advocates reiterate calls to abolish ICE after fatal shootings in Houston, Maine
entries.summary: <p>Following fatal shootings involving Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents in Houston and Maine, Chicago immigrant rights advocates say the incidents underscore their calls to abolish ICE and restrict enforcement tactics that have already caused harm in Illinois.</p><p>The two shootings happened less than a week apart, both during attempted traffic stops, intensifying scrutiny over the tactics used in immigration enforcement. The Trump administration reacted with mixed signals over ICE’s use of traffic stops, with administration officials <a class="Link" href="https://chicago.suntimes.com/nation-world/2026/07/14/trump-administration-orders-ice-to-suspend-most-vehicle-stops-after-two-deadly-shootings-ap-source" >directing agents to suspend most stops</a> before President Donald Trump said he wanted them to continue.</p><p>The incidents have resonated with Chicago-area advocates who point to the September killing of Silverio Villegas González, who was fatally shot by an ICE agent during an attempted traffic stop in Franklin Park, and the October shooting of Marimar Martinez by a Border Patrol agent.</p><p>For immigrant rights advocates, the debate over traffic stops is just one piece of what they describe as a broader approach to immigration enforcement.</p><p>Brandon Lee, spokesperson for the Illinois Coalition for Immigrant and Refugee Rights, said limiting one tactic doesn’t get at what advocates see as the root issue: the Trump administration’s efforts to instill fear in immigrant communities and carry out mass deportations.</p><p>“All tactics that Trump is using, whether it’s traffic stops or taking people as they’re going to and from court, or taking people at check ins, all of it has the same end result, which is families being separated, which is communities being disrupted. And, in some cases, it’s fatal,” Lee said.</p><p>“We’re not looking at it as like them abandoning one tactic makes our communities any safer because they still have billions of dollars and a wide range of other tactics at their disposal."</p><p>While Lee said advocates continue to call for abolishing ICE, that remains unlikely under the Trump administration.</p><p>Meanwhile, he said, Congress and state officials can put “meaningful guardrails” on ICE. That could include protections for immigrants whose work authorization or deportation protections are at risk.</p><p>Lee said advocates are also want timely processing of DACA renewals, and protections for immigrants who could lose legal status because of federal policy changes, including Haitians and others whose temporary protected status may be revoked.</p><p>At the state level, Lee said it’s important that officials enforce two Illinois laws: one prohibits local law enforcement from cooperating with federal immigration authorities, the other prevents federal immigration agents from making civil arrests at courthouses.</p><p>Kayla Nguyen, media co-chair of the Chicago Alliance Against Racist and Political Repression, said the recent shootings reflect what her group sees as a broader pattern of enforcement practices that disproportionately harm Black and Brown communities.</p><p>Her group, which hosted a vigil Wednesday night for the victims in Houston and Maine, has demanded an end to what they call pretextual traffic stops — meaning, her group says, when officers pull over drivers for a minor infraction as an excuse to fish for more serious crimes.</p><p>“We believe that traffic stops [by ICE] should end, period,” Nguyen said. “Of course, these kinds of murders are not just related to traffic stops. They’re linked to broader repression that exists against the immigrants rights in general.”</p><p>She agreed with Lee that state officials need to continue enforcing state laws that protect immigrants and mitigate ICE’s use of force.</p><p>The 18-member Illinois Legislative Latino Caucus also condemned the recent shootings and called for an end to what it described as escalating immigration enforcement in Illinois. The caucus pointed to concerns about ICE activity near courthouses.</p><p>“The persecution of our immigrant community needs to stop,” the caucus said in a statement. “ICE needs to leave our cities and leave our communities alone. We need to stand up and fight against the extremists in our country, because our immigrant neighbors deserve to feel protected and safe in our communities.”</p><p>U.S. Sen. Dick Durbin, D-Ill., also called for accountability following the shootings in Houston and Maine, saying there should be “full, fair, independent investigations” into the deaths. He urged the Department of Homeland Security not to deport witnesses before they can participate in investigations.</p><p>“We must rein in ICE abuses before another life is lost,” Durbin said.</p>

entries.title: Judge gives ex-Summit police chief three years in bribery plot: 'You sounded like a gangster'
entries.summary: <p>When a federal judge sentenced former<b> </b>Summit<b> </b>police<b> </b>chief<b> </b>John<b> </b>Kosmowski<b> </b>on Wednesday to three years in prison for<b> </b>bribery, conspiracy<b> </b>and obstruction of justice, he quoted the former top suburban cop’s recorded words right back at him.</p><p>A secret government cooperator<b> </b>caught<b> </b>Kosmowski<b> </b>in 2022 insisting<b> </b>“there is no truth,”<b> </b>and<b> </b>“it’s gonna be their version against ours. It always is.”</p><p>U.S. District Judge Steven<b> </b>Seeger<b> </b>told him Wednesday, “you sounded like a gangster. Who talks like that? … Who says that?"</p><div class="RelatedList Enhancement" data-module data-align-center> <div class="RelatedList-title">Related</div> <ul class="RelatedList-items"> <li class="RelatedList-items-item"> <a class="Link" href="https://chicago.suntimes.com/chicago-corruption-trials/2025/12/10/former-summit-police-chief-john-kosmowski-convicted-bribery-conspiracy-obstruction-justice" >Former Summit police chief convicted of bribery, conspiracy, obstruction of justice</a> </li> </ul> </div> <p>“Here’s the bottom line,” Seeger told him, seven months <a class="Link" href="https://chicago.suntimes.com/chicago-corruption-trials/2025/12/10/former-summit-police-chief-john-kosmowski-convicted-bribery-conspiracy-obstruction-justice" target="_blank" >after Kosmowski’s conviction</a> by a jury. “You took a bribe, and you tried to cover it up. The evidence at trial was compelling. The evidence was strong. The case wasn’t close.”</p><p>The judge also complained about the steady drumbeat of public corruption cases that have hit his courtroom and others at the Dirksen Federal Courthouse, insisting “there must be something in the water in Lake Michigan that makes Chicago a breeding ground for corruption.”</p><p>“How on Earth has the message not gotten out in the Chicagoland area, to public officials, that they cannot take bribes?” Seeger said. “I don’t understand why public corruption has so deeply infested the body politic in this town. I don’t get it.”</p><p>Kosmowski displayed no obvious reaction when Seeger announced the sentence, though a cry went up from the gallery on his side of the courtroom, where several relatives and supporters had gathered.</p><p>Defense attorney Thomas<b> </b>Leinenweber<b> </b>tried to convince Seeger to give Kosmowski a year of home detention instead, arguing that Kosmowski had already lost his career<b> </b>and livelihood, his reputation, and a pension worth $3 million.</p><p>Before he was sentenced, Kosmowski told the judge “there is not a day that goes by that I do not think about those decisions and the disappointment they have caused. ... What has been most difficult for me is knowing that these actions are inconsistent with the way I’ve tried to live my life."</p><p>Kosmowski,<b> </b>58, spent<b> </b>more than<b> </b>30 years with the Summit police department, according to Leinenweber. Kosmowski also spent more than a decade<b> </b>of his career<b> </b>as a Drug Enforcement Administration<b> </b>task force officer, playing a role in an investigation<b> </b>of the Sinaloa drug cartel, Leinenweber wrote in a court filing.</p><div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="Enhancement-item" data-crop=""> <figure class="Figure"><a class="AnchorLink" id="image-0d0000" whole, your entire life’s work.”</p><p>Still, the judge added, “I was thinking about giving you a higher sentence.”</p><p>Seeger is the same judge who gave a nearly five-year prison sentence<b> </b>to <a class="Link" href="https://chicago.suntimes.com/crime/2022/5/25/23141317/luis-arroyo-sentencing-wire-fraud-bribery-terry-link-sweepstakes-gambling-machines" target="_blank" >former state Rep. Luis Arroyo</a>, and a five-and-a-half year<b> </b>sentence<b> </b>to <a class="Link" href="https://chicago.suntimes.com/2023/10/11/23913020/businessman-james-t-weiss-gets-5-1-2-years-in-prison-for-bribing-2-state-lawmakers-lying-to-the-fbi" target="_blank" >businessman James T. Weiss</a>, for a separate bribery scheme that revolved around gambling legislation<b> </b>in Springfield.</p><p>The case against Kosmowski began when a grand jury handed up an indictment against<b> </b>him<b> </b>and Summit building inspector William<b> </b>Mundy<b> </b>in<b> </b>2022, alleging the men conspired in 2017 to use their influence with Summit Village President Sergio<b> </b>Rodriguez to help bar owner Krzystof Hodurek<b> </b>secure a liquor license transfer.</p><p>Grand jury subpoenas went out<b> </b>early in March 2022, records show. Then, on March 14, 2022, Kosmowski confronted Mundy outside a wake. That’s when Kosmowski made the comments that caught Seeger’s attention.</p><p>Mundy was recording as<b> </b>Kosmowski<b> </b>asked, “what’s going on with this thing with [Hodurek]” and said, “we didn’t do anything for him. Remember that.”</p><p>“What if he tells the f---ing truth?” Mundy asked.</p><p>“What?” Kosmowski replied. “There is no truth.”</p><div class="RelatedList Enhancement" data-module data-align-center> <div class="RelatedList-title">Related</div> <ul class="RelatedList-items"> <li class="RelatedList-items-item"> <a class="Link" href="https://chicago.suntimes.com/crime/2022/5/25/23141317/luis-arroyo-sentencing-wire-fraud-bribery-terry-link-sweepstakes-gambling-machines" >Nearly 5-year prison sentence for ex-state Rep. Luis Arroyo in bribery scheme: ‘You were a dirty politician who was on the take’</a> </li> </ul> </div> <p>Mundy testified that he and Kosmowski agreed to split a $10,000 bribe from Hodurek. But Kosmowski insisted to Mundy in 2022 that he’d actually repaid a $7,000 “loan” from Hodurek.</p><p>“Here’s the thing,” Kosmowski went on to tell Mundy. “No matter what we say, remember this: It’s gonna be their version against ours. It always is.”</p><p>Mundy pleaded guilty in 2023 to a bribery conspiracy and filing a false tax return. He then took the stand when Kosmowski went to trial in December, calling Kosmowski’s story about a loan “bullsh--.”</p><p>Though jurors didn’t hear it during Kosmowski’s trial, Assistant U.S. Attorney Jared<b> </b>Hasten<b> </b>also told the judge about a recording in which Kosmowski<b> </b>allegedly referred to a government cooperator as<b> </b>“a little rat.”</p><p>Seeger told Kosmowski, “I’m not saying it’s going to affect my sentence. I don’t think it will.”</p><p>Still, he added, “it’s not a resume builder.”</p><p>“I don’t think it’s a great sign of character to refer to a government cooperator as ‘a little rat’ when you are the chief of police,”<b> </b>Seeger told him. “Who does that? That’s how gangsters talk.”</p>

entries.title: As cyclospora concerns spread, farmers markets highlight importance of local food access
entries.summary: <p>Concerns over a statewide cyclospora outbreak have caused some Chicago shoppers to rethink where they buy their produce.</p><p>Enter farmers markets.</p><p>Chelsa Moore, an urban planner who works near the Pullman Farmers Market, said the recent outbreak has made her more aware of where her food comes from.</p><p>“I was just down a ton of rabbit holes this morning because I do buy a lot of fresh produce,” Moore said. “It’s just made me even more aware of what I’m getting.”</p><p>Moore said she has started to lean more towards farmers markets because she values knowing who is growing her food, in addition to having a relationship with the vendors.</p><p>“I’m like, all right, well, I got to pivot because I can’t get what I usually get from the stores,” she said.</p><div Of those cases, 111 were domestically acquired, 105 involved travel outside the United States and 24 are still under investigation. The state has reported 21 hospitalizations and no deaths.</p><p>The source of the outbreak is still unknown according to the IDPH. However, the virus can be contracted by consuming food or water contaminated with feces and recommends consumers wash their hands before preparing food and thoroughly clean all produce before eating, cutting or cooking.</p><p>At the Pullman market, vendors said the outbreak has led to more talk about food safety.</p><p>“It’s in the air, it’s in the conversations,” said Elijah-Michelle Mueller, one of the market managers. “People want someone to have a conversation with about it.”</p><p>But Mueller said the market's importance goes beyond this outbreak. Farmers markets provide fresh food options to communities that historically haven't had them.</p><p>“There are a lot of people who think farmers markets are a North Side thing,” Mueller said. “Everyone deserves fresh produce.”</p><p>Ramona Baptiste, also known as “Chef Mo,” said her work at the Pullman market is focused on helping residents make healthier choices by showing them how to prepare fresh ingredients in ways that fit their everyday lives. These days that also means demonstrating how to properly prep and clean their groceries.</p><p>“I’m here to tell you what to do with it or how you can incorporate it with what you have on hand at entries.summary: <h2>Moon Alert</h2> <p>Caution! Avoid shopping (except food and gas) and important decisions until 7:30 p.m. After that, the moon moves from Leo into Virgo.</p><h2>Aries (March 21-April 19)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-7b0000" name="html-embed-module-7b0000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>A <b>positive</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> A playful day! Enjoy socializing with others, especially romantic outings, sports, and fun activities with children. At a deeper level, you feel you're seeing the world through new eyes — which, in fact, you are.</p><h2>Taurus (April 20-May 20)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-4d0000" name="html-embed-module-4d0000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>An <b>average</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> Home, family and your private life are your priority today. Restrict spending to food and gas because of the moon alert (see above). Be grateful for opportunities to improve family relations because this is possible for you this year. Bonus!</p><h2>Gemini (May 21-June 20)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-7b0000" name="html-embed-module-7b0000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>A <b>positive</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> Be careful because most of this day is a moon alert, which means avoid important decisions and restrict spending to food and gas. However, you're full of ideas today! You want to impulsively go off in a number of directions. Be careful.</p><h2>Cancer (June 21-July 22)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-4d0000" name="html-embed-module-4d0000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>An <b>average</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> Today's emphasis is on money, shopping, earnings and cash flow. However, most of this day is a moon alert, which means restrict your spending to food and gas. This will require mindfulness and some self-discipline. (And you hate to make a purchase you regret.)</p><h2>Leo (July 23-Aug. 22)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-7b0000" name="html-embed-module-7b0000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>A <b>positive</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> Today the moon alert is in your sign for most of the day. This means it's a marvelous day to socialize. It's also a wonderful day to appreciate the arts or to create something or make art. However, avoid important decisions and restrict spending money, except for food and gas.</p><h2>Virgo (Aug. 23-Sept. 22)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-4d0000" name="html-embed-module-4d0000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>An <b>average</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> This is a popular time for you, especially because friends from the past are back in your world again. Enjoy schmoozing with others because today has an easygoing, unpredictable quality to it. Don't volunteer for anything. Don't agree to anything important.</p><h2>Libra (Sept. 23-Oct. 22)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-7b0000" name="html-embed-module-7b0000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>A <b>positive</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> This is a great day to schmooze with others and enjoy the company of friends as well as groups and organizations. However, avoid important commitments. Don't volunteer for anything. entries.title: Man, 70, hospitalized after being pulled from Montrose Harbor
entries.summary: <p>A man was hospitalized after being pulled from Lake Michigan Wednesday afternoon, according to Chicago police.</p><p>The man, 70, was pulled from the water by people nearby in the 300 block of West Montrose Harbor Drive at 3:58 p.m., police said. He was taken to St. Joseph Hospital in critical condition.<br></p>
